items.caption:
Do you dream in color? Most people under 25 do.
In one diary study of 60 people, only 4.4% of under-25s' dreams were black and white, vs about a quarter for over-55s raised on black-and-white media. A link, not proof.

Cameras caught drivers falling asleep before crashes.
In a 2018 AAA Foundation dashcam study of 3,593 drivers, 9.5% of all crashes involved drowsiness, about 8 times the federal estimate.
